lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions; FEP and SAO follow own guidelines; Medicare Advantage references LCD L38914
sections_in_order: Reimbursement Information (Required Documentation, LOINC, BSA/Mosteller, Schnur Sliding Scale table)
criteria_location: Position Statement (first page) holds the criteria; the Schnur table, BSA formula and required documentation live in the later Reimbursement Information section, so the numeric threshold is not in the criteria section.
procedures_covered: Reduction mammaplasty CPT 19318 for symptomatic macromastia
Symmetry reduction on contralateral breast after mastectomy
Symmetry reduction after lumpectomy or radiation
Liposuction as adjunct (included) and as sole procedure (investigational)

logic.top_level: all (A: symptom group AND B: Schnur) plus separate indications for post-cancer symmetry

k_of_n.quote: A minimum 6-week history of AT LEAST TWO OF THE FOLLOWING that are unresponsive to conservative therapy

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Closing paragraph: not necessary 'when performed for cosmetic purposes or for the correction of deformities resulting from previous cosmetic surgery'; investigational for 'all other indications'; liposuction alone investigational.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: A minimum 6-week history of AT LEAST TWO OF THE FOLLOWING that are unresponsive to conservative therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Is the 6 weeks applied to each symptom, to the two together, or to conservative therapy? Does 'unresponsive' apply to each symptom?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Reduction mammaplasty performed to achieve symmetry following lumpectomy or radiation therapy for breast cancer may meet the definition of medical necessity
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'may meet' is not a criterion; no conditions given

unresponsive to conservative therapy (e.g., support bra, wide bra straps, analgesia, NSAIDs, physical therapy, exercises, heat treatment, cold treatment)
at or above the 22nd percentile on the Schnur Sliding Scale, based on the individual's body surface area (BSA) using the Mosteller formula
symmetry on a non-disease and contralateral breast following a mastectomy

Symptoms and duration; Height and weight; Statement of anticipated amount of breast tissue to be removed per breast

thresholds.quote: AT LEAST TWO OF THE FOLLOWING

superficial dermatitis occurring on adjacent skin surfaces (e.g., breast fold)

Schnur table in a different section, two-column flattened
Formula appears twice (cm/kg divisor 3600; in/lb divisor 3131)
Planned (pre-op) grams vs removed grams: the criterion is about planned removal, the note about actual

Prospective plan checked against retrospective actual removal
